title: TSMC Q4 2025 results
summary: TSMC Q4 2025 revenue was $33.73B, gross margin 62.3%, advanced technologies were 77% of wafer revenue, and 2026 capex was expected at $52B-$56B.

title: SemiAnalysis AI Capacity Constraints CoWoS and HBM Supply Chain
summary: SemiAnalysis identified CoWoS and HBM as AI accelerator bottlenecks and explained CoWoS as TSMC 2.5D packaging that integrates logic and HBM on an interposer.

title: SemiAnalysis GB200 Hardware Architecture Component Supply Chain and BOM
summary: SemiAnalysis mapped GB200 rack-scale architecture and component implications, including that many data centers cannot support very high rack density without direct-to-chip liquid cooling.
